close_reason: Deleted crate-jmap-sharing-server/tests/memory_backend.rs (3-line mod-common stub contributing zero tests since JMAP-hwdv.2). Test count unchanged at 25. Chat-server and filenode-server (.3 and .4 just landed) have no analogous stub file — their integration tests are in named binaries already. Commit 7666c4c.
description:
After JMAP-hwdv.2 extracted MemoryBackend from tests/common/mod.rs to src/memory.rs, the integration test binary `crate-jmap-sharing-server/tests/memory_backend.rs` is now a 3-line stub (just `mod common;`) that runs zero tests, because its sole purpose was to drag in the `mod tests { }` block formerly inside `tests/common/mod.rs`. That block now lives in `src/memory.rs` and runs as crate-level unit tests.

Cleanup: delete `crate-jmap-sharing-server/tests/memory_backend.rs`.

Acceptance: `cargo test -p jmap-sharing-server` test count unchanged after deletion (the binary contributes zero tests today).

Same cleanup likely applies to sibling crates after JMAP-hwdv.3 / .4 if their pre-extraction `tests/common/mod.rs` similarly had a `mod tests { }` block plus a tests/*backend*.rs stub. File analogous follow-ups when those land.
title: Delete dead tests/memory_backend.rs stub after JMAP-hwdv.2 extraction
